hero.title: Support my work!
desc: If you appreciate what I do and want to help me continue, here's how you can do it.
Any help is truly appreciated 💖

direct.title: ☕ Treat me to a coffee ☕
direct.desc: Support me directly, with a tip, a sponsorship or a gift.

desc: Sponsor me on GitHub, monthly or as a one-time contribution.
It goes straight into the time I spend building and maintaining my projects.
Leave a one-time tip or join as a member to support my projects.
Tips on Ko-fi carry no platform fees, so almost everything you give reaches me.
Would you rather gift something than donate? Take a look at my Amazon wish list.
It's entirely optional, and every gift is truly appreciated.

mutual.title: 🤝 Mutual Support 🤝
mutual.desc: You help me, I help you: win-win!

desc: GitKraken is a powerful Git client.
Use my link to get 50% off Pro: I receive a small commission, and you get the discount.
Earn Microsoft Rewards points just by searching with Bing.
Join with my referral link and complete the Welcome Quest for bonus points: I also earn a few points when you search.

cause.title: 🍉 Something bigger than me 🍉
desc: Your support means the world to me, truly. But it makes me even happier to know you're also helping people who need it far more than I do.
I think especially of the children in Gaza who have lost everything, and of every child caught in war, wherever it may be.
I won't list any campaigns here: there are too many, and I can't verify them all.
If you decide to help, choose people or organizations you can check yourself, ideally ones working directly on the ground and transparent about where the money goes.
And if you do, feel free to tell me. It would mean a lot to me, and even more to them.

thanks.title: 💖 Thank you for being here 💖
desc: Whether you donate, share my work, or just stop by, it means a lot.
If you'd like to tell me something, including about the thought above, I'd love to hear from you.
